subject: Setting different axis limits for different rows/columns of facet grid

messages.author: 7f3a0992842494e7
messages.subject: Setting different axis limits for different rows/columns of facet grid
parts:
I have a 2x2 facet grid and I'd like to have one set of limits for the
top row (0,0.4) and another set of limits for the bottom row (0,1).
Is this possible?

I was thinking along these lines, although it obviously did not work.
scale_y_continuous(limits=c(0,0.4,0,1))

( Apologies if this was already settled in this post. I got a bit
confused reading it.
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/703ccbff21dec342/a49a69bad79767f5?lnk=gst&q=limit+scale+facet#a49a69bad79767f5
